# MarkdownEditor

> Compose Markdown with draggable blocks, tables, slash commands, people mentions, formatting, and application-owned image uploads. Choose a rich-text or live-preview engine.

Status: beta.

This file matches the installed `markdown-editor` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/markdown-editor.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/markdown-editor.md`.

## Composition

### Markdown composition

Markdown strings stay application-owned. Both alternatives share these parts. Content includes block drag handles (Alt+ArrowUp/ArrowDown also moves blocks) and table grips for moving, aligning, inserting, and deleting rows and columns. Suggestions adds slash commands and accepts people with persistent profile URLs; mentions save as Markdown links. Supply onUploadImage to enable image paste and drop. isUrlAllowed changes which link and image URLs stay editable (a file-based editor can accept relative links). Rich text renders a TipTap document and normalizes the Markdown it saves. Live preview edits the Markdown text itself, so what you type is what you save. Pass extensions to add editor extensions after the built-in set: TipTap extensions for Rich text, CodeMirror extensions for Live preview. Both props are read once, when the editor mounts.

```tsx
<MarkdownEditor>
  <MarkdownEditorToolbar />
  <MarkdownEditorContent />
  <MarkdownEditorSuggestions />
  <MarkdownEditorUploads />
</MarkdownEditor>
```

### Selection bubble menu

Use MarkdownEditorBubbleMenu instead of, or alongside, MarkdownEditorToolbar. It appears above non-empty text selections outside code blocks and reuses the toolbar's text style, mark, and link controls; pass children to append custom controls.

```tsx
<MarkdownEditor>
  <MarkdownEditorContent />
  <MarkdownEditorBubbleMenu />
  <MarkdownEditorSuggestions />
</MarkdownEditor>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { MarkdownEditor, MarkdownEditorContent } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor";
import { MarkdownEditorBubbleMenu } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/bubble-menu";
import { MarkdownEditorSuggestions } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/suggestions";
import { MarkdownEditorToolbar, MarkdownEditorUploads } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/toolbar";
import { Label } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/label";
import { Markdown } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/markdown";
import { Switch } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/switch";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

const people = [
  { id: "alex", label: "Alex Morgan", href: "/people/alex", description: "Design" },
  { id: "sam", label: "Sam Rivera", href: "/people/sam", description: "Engineering" },
  { id: "jordan", label: "Jordan Lee", href: "/people/jordan", description: "Product" },
];

const initialMarkdown =
  "## Project feedback\n\nWe need **clearer feedback** on the new dashboard.\n\n- [x] Describe the issue\n- [ ] Add a screenshot\n\n> Keep the next step easy to find.";

export function MarkdownEditorExample() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initialMarkdown);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <MarkdownEditor value={value} onValueChange={setValue}>
        <MarkdownEditorToolbar />
        <MarkdownEditorContent label="Project description" placeholder="Describe your project…" />
        <MarkdownEditorSuggestions mentions={people} />
        <MarkdownEditorUploads />
      </MarkdownEditor>
      <Text size="label" tone="muted">
        Type / for blocks or @ to mention someone. Drag the handle beside a block to reorder it.
      </Text>
      <section aria-label="Saved Markdown preview">
        <Markdown content={value} mode="static" />
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

export function MarkdownEditorBubbleMenuExample() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initialMarkdown);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <MarkdownEditor value={value} onValueChange={setValue}>
        <MarkdownEditorContent label="Project notes" placeholder="Write your notes…" />
        <MarkdownEditorBubbleMenu />
        <MarkdownEditorSuggestions mentions={people} />
        <MarkdownEditorUploads />
      </MarkdownEditor>
      <Text size="label" tone="muted">
        Select text to format it, type / for blocks, or @ to mention someone.
      </Text>
    </div>
  );
}

export function MarkdownEditorReadOnlyExample() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(initialMarkdown);
  const [locked, setLocked] = useState(true);
  const lockId = useId();
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 justify-self-start">
        <Switch id={lockId} checked={locked} onCheckedChange={setLocked} />
        <Label htmlFor={lockId}>Lock while in review</Label>
      </div>
      <MarkdownEditor value={value} onValueChange={setValue} readOnly={locked}>
        <MarkdownEditorToolbar />
        <MarkdownEditorContent label="Description in review" placeholder="Describe your project…" />
        <MarkdownEditorSuggestions mentions={people} />
        <MarkdownEditorUploads />
      </MarkdownEditor>
      <Text size="label" tone="muted">
        {locked
          ? "Read-only content stays selectable and focusable, so it can be copied and read by assistive technology."
          : "Unlocked. Edit the description, then lock it again."}
      </Text>
    </div>
  );
}
```
